verdict.rationale: WezTerm is a locally installed terminal emulator and multiplexer. It has no hosted API or account system, so issuing scoped or least-privilege API credentials is a category error for this kind of product. The evidence shows only a local CLI controlling a running GUI or mux instance, and no credential-issuance concept.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
